# Generated by scripts/gitignore_cases.py with git version 2.53.0. Do not edit.
case literal name matches at any level
p "foo"
f 1 "foo"
f 1 "a/foo"
f 1 "a/b/foo"
f 0 "foobar"
f 0 "barfoo"
d 1 "dir/foo"
f 1 "dir/foo/x"
end
case leading slash anchors to the root
p "/foo"
d 1 "foo"
f 1 "foo/x"
f 0 "a/foo"
f 0 "afoo"
end
case slash in the middle anchors to the root
p "a/foo"
d 1 "a/foo"
f 1 "a/foo/z"
f 0 "x/a/foo"
f 0 "a/b/foo"
end
case trailing slash matches directories only
p "foo/"
f 0 "foo"
d 1 "x/foo"
f 1 "x/foo/inner"
f 0 "y/foo"
end
case trailing slash with a slash in the middle
p "a/foo/"
d 1 "a/foo"
f 1 "a/foo/x"
d 0 "b/a/foo"
f 0 "c/a/foo"
end
case leading and trailing slash
p "/out/"
d 1 "out"
f 1 "out/x"
d 0 "a/out"
d 0 "out2"
end
case star matches within a name
p "*.log"
f 1 "a.log"
f 1 "x/a.log"
f 0 "log"
f 1 ".log"
f 0 "a.log.txt"
d 1 "d.log"
f 1 "d.log/x"
end
case star does not match a slash
p "a/*.c"
f 1 "a/x.c"
f 0 "a/b/x.c"
f 1 "a/.c"
f 0 "b/a/x.c"
end
case anchored star
p "/*.c"
f 1 "a.c"
f 0 "d/a.c"
end
case star alone
p "*"
f 1 "a"
d 1 "d"
f 1 "d/b"
f 1 ".hidden"
end
case question mark matches one character but not a slash
p "?.txt"
p "x/a?b"
f 1 "a.txt"
f 0 "ab.txt"
f 0 ".txt"
f 0 "x/a/b"
f 1 "x/acb"
f 0 "x/ab"
end
case character ranges
p "file[0-9].txt"
f 1 "file1.txt"
f 0 "filea.txt"
f 0 "file10.txt"
f 0 "file.txt"
end
case negated character class with !
p "[!a]x"
f 1 "bx"
f 0 "ax"
f 0 "x"
f 1 ".x"
end
case negated character class with ^
p "[^a]y"
f 1 "by"
f 0 "ay"
end
case closing bracket first in a class
p "[]]z"
f 1 "]z"
f 0 "z"
f 0 "a]z"
end
case dash last in a class
p "[a-]q"
f 1 "aq"
f 1 "-q"
f 0 "bq"
end
case named character classes
p "[[:digit:]]d"
p "[[:upper:][:punct:]]e"
f 1 "1d"
f 0 "ad"
f 1 "Ae"
f 1 "_e"
f 0 "ae"
end
case unterminated class matches nothing
p "[ab"
f 0 "[ab"
f 0 "a"
f 0 "b"
end
case escaped special characters
p "\*"
p "a\?b"
p "\[x]"
f 1 "*"
f 0 "a"
f 1 "a?b"
f 0 "axb"
f 1 "[x]"
f 0 "x"
end
case escaped hash and bang
p "\#hash"
p "\!bang"
f 1 "#hash"
f 1 "!bang"
f 0 "bang"
end
case comments and blank lines
p "# comment"
p ""
p "#not"
f 0 "# comment"
f 0 "#not"
f 0 "comment"
end
case trailing spaces are ignored unless escaped
p "trail  "
p "sp\ "
f 1 "trail"
f 0 "trail "
f 1 "sp "
f 0 "sp"
end
case trailing tab is kept
p "tab%09"
f 0 "tab"
f 1 "tab%09"
end
case carriage return at end of line
p "crlf%0D"
f 1 "crlf"
f 0 "crlf%0D"
end
case trailing backslash matches nothing
p "foo\"
f 0 "foo"
f 0 "foo\"
end
case characters special to regular expressions are literal
p "a+b"
p "(x)"
p "{y}"
p "$z"
p "p|q"
p "dot.c"
p "c++"
p "^h"
f 1 "a+b"
f 0 "aab"
f 1 "(x)"
f 0 "x"
f 1 "{y}"
f 0 "y"
f 1 "$z"
f 0 "z"
f 1 "p|q"
f 0 "p"
f 1 "dot.c"
f 0 "dotxc"
f 1 "c++"
f 0 "c"
f 1 "^h"
f 0 "h"
end
case names are case sensitive
p "Foo"
f 1 "Foo"
f 0 "foo"
f 0 "FOO"
end
case negation re-includes
p "*.log"
p "!keep.log"
f 1 "a.log"
f 0 "keep.log"
f 0 "x/keep.log"
f 1 "x/a.log"
end
case last matching pattern decides
p "!keep.log"
p "*.log"
f 1 "keep.log"
f 1 "a.log"
end
case negation cannot re-include below an ignored directory
p "build"
p "!build/keep.txt"
d 1 "build"
f 1 "build/keep.txt"
f 1 "build/x"
end
case re-including a directory does not re-include its files
p "*"
p "!src"
d 0 "src"
f 1 "src/main.cpp"
f 1 "other"
d 1 "deep/src"
end
case re-including directories and some files
p "*"
p "!*/"
p "!*.c"
f 0 "a.c"
f 1 "a.h"
d 0 "d"
f 0 "d/a.c"
f 1 "d/a.h"
f 0 "d/e/b.c"
end
case negated directory pattern
p "d*"
p "!dir/"
d 0 "dir"
f 0 "dir/x"
f 1 "dfile"
d 1 "d2"
end
case leading double star
p "**/foo"
f 1 "foo"
f 1 "a/foo"
f 1 "a/b/foo"
f 1 "b/foo/x"
f 0 "xfoo"
end
case leading double star with a slash
p "**/foo/bar"
f 1 "foo/bar"
f 1 "a/foo/bar"
f 1 "a/b/foo/bar"
f 0 "foo/x/bar"
f 0 "bar"
end
case trailing double star matches everything inside
p "abc/**"
d 0 "abc"
f 1 "abc/x"
f 1 "abc/y/z"
f 0 "xabc/x"
f 0 "d/abc/x"
end
case double star in the middle matches any number of directories
p "a/**/b"
f 1 "a/b"
f 1 "a/x/b"
f 1 "a/x/y/b"
f 0 "ab"
f 0 "a/xb"
f 0 "c/a/b"
end
case double star not alone in a component acts as a star
p "a**b"
p "**foo"
p "bar**"
p "x/**y"
f 1 "ab"
f 1 "axb"
f 1 "c/ab"
f 1 "foo"
f 1 "xfoo"
f 1 "c/xfoo"
f 1 "bar"
f 1 "barz"
f 1 "x/y"
f 1 "x/ay"
f 0 "x/a/y"
end
case double star alone matches everything
p "**"
f 1 "a"
d 1 "d"
f 1 "d/e/f"
end
case double star with trailing slash matches directories
p "**/"
f 0 "a"
d 1 "d"
d 1 "d/e"
end
case star with trailing slash matches directories
p "*/"
f 0 "f"
d 1 "d"
d 1 "d/e"
f 1 "d/f"
end
case lone slash and lone bang match nothing
p "/"
p "!"
f 0 "a"
d 0 "d"
end
case names starting with a dot
p ".svn"
d 1 ".svn"
f 1 ".svn/entries"
d 1 "a/.svn"
f 0 "a/.svnignore"
end
case typical ignore file
p "build/"
p "*.pyc"
p "__pycache__"
p ".git"
p "node_modules/"
p "*.o"
p "/artifacts"
p "**/tmp/**"
d 1 "build"
d 1 "src/build"
f 0 "lib/build"
f 1 "src/a.pyc"
d 1 "src/__pycache__"
f 1 "src/__pycache__/x.pyc"
d 1 "node_modules"
d 1 "web/node_modules"
f 1 "src/a.o"
d 1 "artifacts"
d 0 "src/artifacts"
f 1 "tmp/x"
f 1 "src/tmp/x"
d 0 "src/tmp"
f 0 "src/main.c"
end
